paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption: Performance of various RL methods with and without self-reflection.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for different methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels "Mathverse", "MMLU", and "Physics", with each category having grouped bars. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62% and tick labels at intervals of 2%. Each category features six bars that are color-coded and patterned according to a legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes). In Mathverse, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches approximately 53%, while while the PPO bar is slightly above 53% and the DAPO + Self-reflection is slightly above 56% and remaining with 53-56%. For MMLU, bars range from slightly above 54% (PPO) to about 57% (SRPO), and in Physics, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches close to 61%, with the PPO bar at approximately 57% and remaining are within these ranges. They do not follow any specific sorting order, and three bars have diagonal stripes in them. A legend is provided at top with the category and their bar.

Die Abbildung ist ein Balkendiagramm und veranschaulicht die Genauigkeitsprozentsätze für verschiedene Methoden in drei Kategorien: Mathverse, MMLU und Physik. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit 3 Kategorien: "Mathverse", "MMLU" und "Physics". Die vertikale Achse trägt die Bezeichnung "Accuracy (%)" und verwendet eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von 50 bis 62 und Teilstrichen im Abstand von 2. Jede Kategorie hat 6 verschieden Balken. Von links nach rechts sind die Balken blau gestreift, blau, orange gestreift, orange, grün gestreift und grün. Bei Mathverse sind alle Balken zwischen einer Genauigkeit von 52 und 56. Bei MMLU sind alle Balken zwischen einer Genauigkeit von 54,5 und 57. Bei Physics sind alle Balken zwischen einer Genauigkeit von 57 und 61. Eine Legende ist in der linken oberen Ecke und bezeichnet blau als "DAPO + Self-reflection", das gestreifte blau als "DAPO", das orange als "SRPO", das gestreifte orange als "GRPO", das grün als "PPO + Self-reflection" und das gestreifte grün als "PPO".

The X-axis contains the categorical labels Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, with each category having grouped bars. The Y-axis represents accuracy, labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62% and tick labels at intervals of 2%. Each category features six bars that are color-coded and patterned according to a legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes). Стълбовидната диаграма илюстрира процентите на точност за различните методи в три категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Оста X съдържа категориалните етикети Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, като всяка категория има групирани стълбчета. Оста Y представлява точността, обозначена като „Точност (%)“, с линейна скала, варираща от 50% до 62% и етикети с отметки на интервали от 2%. Всяка категория включва шест стълбчета, които са цветово кодирани и моделирани съгласно легенда: DAPO+Самоотражение (плътно синьо), DAPO (синьо с диагонални ивици), SRPO (плътно оранжево), GRPO (оранжево с диагонални ивици), PPO+Самоотражение (плътно зелено) и PPO (зелено с диагонални ивици). В Mathverse стълбчето DAPO+Самоотражение достига най-високата точка сред тях, достигайки приблизително 56%, докато стълбчето DAPO е най-ниското с 53%. За MMLU, стълбчетата варират от около 53% (PPO) до 56% (GRPO), а във физиката, стълбчето DAPO+Самоотражение достига близо до високата точка от около 61%, като стълбчето PPO е в най-ниската точка от приблизително 57%. Подредбата във всяка категория следва реда от легендата и не изглежда да има визуално подчертани стълбчета с допълнително форматиране, като например оцветяване или удебеляване.

The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for different methods across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the benchmarks which are, from left to right; Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark category has grouped bars representing the Reinforcement Learning framework used in training. The vertical axis represents is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62 and tick labels at intervals of 2. Each category features six bars that are color-coded and patterned according to a legend: "DAPO+Self-reflection" (solid blue), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (light orange with diagonal stripes), "PPO+Self-reflection" (solid green), and PPO (light green with diagonal stripes). In Mathverse, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches approximately 56%, with the SRPO bar close behind slightly under 56%. The PPO+Self-reflection bar is at roughly 54.5%, while the other bas trail behind at approximately 53.5%. Regarding MMLU, The DAPPO+Self-reflection and SRPO lead at roughly 57%, with the SPRO bar slightly higher. The PPO+Self-reflection follows slightly above 56%, and the DAPO and GRPO bars follow at slightly below 56%, with the PPO bar trailing at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches roughly 61%, with SPRO bar following at roughly 60.5%. The PPO+Self-reflection is at about 59%, followd by the GRPO bar with about 58%, the DAPO bar with roughly 57.5%, and the PPO bar coming in at about 57%. Across all benchmarks, the solid bars are always the highest three, with the DAPO+Self-reflection and PPO+Self-reflection consistently leading in accuracy.

该柱状图展示了多种方法在三个任务类别（Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics）中的准确率（Accuracy）表现。横轴为分类标签，分别为 Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics；纵轴为“Accuracy (%)”，采用线性尺度，范围为 50% 到 62%，刻度间隔为 2%。每个任务类别下包含六个并列柱状条，按图例分别表示不同方法：DAPO + Self-reflection（蓝色实心），DAPO（蓝色斜线填充），SRPO（橙色实心），GRPO（橙色斜线填充），PPO + Self-reflection（绿色实心），PPO（绿色斜线填充）。在 Mathverse 任务中，DAPO + Self-reflection 的准确率为 56%，DAPO 为 53%，SRPO 为 55.7%，GRPO 为 53.2%，PPO + Self-reflection 为 54.5%，而 PPO 为 53.1%。在 MMLU 任务中，DAPO + Self-reflection 的准确率为 57.0%，DAPO 为 55.9%，SRPO 为 57.3%，GRPO 为 55.8%，PPO + Self-reflection 为 56.1%，PPO 为 54.6%。在 Physics 任务中，DAPO + Self-reflection 达到 60.8%，DAPO 为 58.5%，SRPO 紧随其后为 60.4%，GRPO 为 58.2%，PPO + Self-reflection 为 59.1%，而 PPO 为 57.3%。各柱状条在每个类别内按图例顺序排列，未采用其他视觉强调方式，如阴影或加粗。
